name: Transaction.Storage.Push
meaning: Appends a value to an array stored at nameSpace.keyOrIndexOrPath inside $$Transaction.Store (creating it if missing) using JSON.Push, and stores the array back as JSONArray. Returns an empty string.
target_signature: transactionStoragePush(ns: string, path: string, value: unknown, type?: JsonType): void
open_question: Hidden global state $$Transaction.Store. Byte-identical body in: Picker Module.fmp12#63; karbon_Build.fmp12#52; karbon_charts.fmp12#52; karbon_log.fmp12#52.

name: IsInList
meaning: Returns true when FilterValues(valueList; filterBy) is not empty.
open_question: Same body as ListIncludes. Byte-identical body in: karbon_Generator.fmp12#100; karbon_kontacts.fmp12#47.

name: IsNotInList
meaning: Returns true when FilterValues(valueList; filterBy) is empty.

name: JSON.FilterPropertyByExpression
meaning: Filters the array at pathToArray in a JSON object by applying a FileMaker expression to one property of each element: builds "JSONGetElement($item;"prop") <expression>" and passes it to JSON.FilterByExpression, then writes the filtered array back at pathToArray. If the path is not an array it returns a JSON.Error.Invalid object.
target_signature: filterArrayByProperty(json: object, path: string, prop: string, predicate: (v: unknown) => boolean): object
open_question: Expression is a FileMaker calculation fragment (e.g. "= 1") from callers; each caller expression must be ported.

name: JSON.Error.Invalid
meaning: Builds a JSON error object: scriptName, descriptor, data, errorCode -2, message "Invalid JSON", type "JSON". The type key is set twice (same value).

name: Log.Entry
meaning: Appends a log entry to $$Log.Data (a JSON array) with Meta.UTC (milliseconds), Meta.Script, Meta.Account, Meta.File, Level, Message and Data. Level must be one of debug, info, notice, warning, error, crit, alert, emerg (RFC 5424), else it becomes "info". Data is stored as text if it is not valid JSON. Returns an empty string.
target_signature: logEntry(level: LogLevel, message: string, data?: unknown): void
open_question: Reads Get(AccountName), Get(FileName) and Get(ScriptName); target needs equivalents. Global $$Log.Data holds state.

name: Log.Reset
meaning: Clears $$Log.Data and returns an empty string.

name: Log.Data
meaning: Returns the current content of $$Log.Data (the log array).

name: _wip_CleanText
meaning: Same logic as CleanText: trims leading and trailing spaces, tabs, CRs and non-breaking spaces by recursion and removes text formatting. Marked _wip_.
open_question: Renamed copy of CleanText (karbon_kontacts id 61, karbon_data id 48) with the recursive call renamed; WIP prefix. No caller found.

name: _wip_BubbleSort_SlideValue
meaning: One pass of a bubble sort over a return-separated list: swaps adjacent values when the first is greater, recursing from position target to the end. Third-party (Brian Dunning cf/27). Marked _wip_.
open_question: The swap concatenates values without separators in the LeftValues/Middle/Right pieces; check. Used only by _wip_BubbleSort.

name: _wip_BubbleSort
meaning: Bubble sort of a return-separated list: runs the pass function iterations times (iterations - 1 recursions). Third-party (Brian Dunning cf/26). Marked _wip_.
